verdict.rationale: Cognee's `.improve` operation enriches an existing graph post-ingestion and `.forget` allows deletion of items or datasets, giving basic update/removal mechanics, but no documentation explicitly describes detecting contradictory facts or merging/superseding conflicting memories automatically. missing for 10: explicit conflict-detection logic, documented merge/supersede behavior when new data contradicts stored facts, and independent verification that .improve resolves rather than just adds information.
